title: Return machine action
statement: For a natural number $m$, a type of states $S$, and a Boolean $b$, define the action that halts and emits $b$ by leaving the input head and all $m$ work-tape heads stationary, making no work-tape writes, emitting the Boolean symbol $b$, and having no successor state.
